name: Clarity of Sight, Greater
body:
School: transmutation; Level bard 2, cleric 2, oracle 3, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: V, S, M (colorless diamonds worth 1,000 gp)

EFFECT

Range: touch
Target: creature touched
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

All penalties to the creature’s vision previously requiring corrective lenses are negated. Unlike clarity of sight, which temporarily improves eyesight through divination magic, this spell permanently changes the shape of the target’s eyes, negating the need for glasses.

A creature who is of Adult age or younger may still develop presbyopia in Middle or Old age.
